title: AnyHarness audit log record (harness/audit.log line)
description: Machine-readable schema for one JSONL record in ~/.agents/harness/audit.log (spec/trust.md §6). The spec text is authoritative if it conflicts with this schema.

actor.description: Who initiated the operation: interactive user, agent/non-interactive context, or bridge daemon.

decision.description: Policy decision taken, for exec.* and policy events.

integrity.description: SRI-syntax sha256 digest relevant to the event.

source.description: Lockfile Source object for install/update events.

details.description: Free-form event payload. MUST NOT contain secrets, credential values, env contents, or file contents.

ManifestRef.description: Pointer to an extension's manifest + version. Mirrored from store-layout.schema.json/$defs/ManifestRef.
